headline: In-Flight Wi-Fi Woes: Why Your 'Fast, Free' Connection is Slowing Down and What's Next
reasoning: This topic has high travel relevance as in-flight Wi-Fi directly impacts passenger experience and productivity. It offers timely information on current issues and future improvements, allowing readers to set expectations or plan accordingly. The source, The Points Guy, is a highly credible travel publication known for its industry insights.
summary: Many airlines' 'fast, free' in-flight Wi-Fi has become sluggish due to increased usage and satellite issues with providers like Viasat and older Panasonic tech. However, new satellite launches and upgrades to Starlink and Amazon-backed services promise significant improvements in the near future.

source_articles.title: Was the 'fast, free' Wi-Fi really slow on your flight, too? Here's what's going on
source_articles.excerpt: Airlines have made big promises about "fast, free" inflight Wi-Fi. But passengers have run into problems logging on during recent flights.
